hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" == *.php ]] && [[ -x vendor/bin/phpcbf ]]; then for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [[ "$f" == *.php ]] && [[ -f "$f" ]]; then vendor/bin/phpcbf -q "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; done; fi
hooks.description: Auto-fix PHPCS style violations on every .php edit. PHPCS would otherwise flag the same fixable issues on every CI run; running phpcbf locally first keeps diffs clean.

hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" == *.php ]]; then for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [[ "$f" == *.php ]] && [[ -f "$f" ]]; then OUT=$(php -l "$f" 2>&1); if echo "$OUT" | grep -qi 'parse error'; then echo "⚠️  Parse error in $f:"; echo "$OUT" | tail -3; fi; fi; done; fi
hooks.description: Run `php -l` on edited PHP files and surface only Parse errors. Catches syntax issues immediately rather than after a deploy + 500.
